name: auxilius-take-home
description: A collaborative task board where multiple users can create, update, and delete tasks in real time. The app uses a React frontend, an Express API, PostgreSQL for persistence, and Socket.IO for live updates across connected clients.

scripts.dev: bash -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; trap "kill 0" EXIT INT TERM; npm run dev -w @auxilius-take-home/api & npm run dev -w @auxilius-take-home/web -- --host 0.0.0.0 & wait'
